executive_summary.headline: The live conversation is about control planes, not demos.
executive_summary.body: Current discussion clusters around trajectory security, stateless tool protocols, identity, and the economics of running agents at scale.

executive_summary.headline: Open and hosted models are becoming a portfolio decision.
executive_summary.body: The practical debate is shifting from which model wins to where each model runs and how its cost and risk are measured.
